title: Keep implementation actors outside verifier decision authority

intent.outcome: Satisfy #2725 by making the existing separation-of-duty decision visible and binding across ordinary start/implement routing, proof admission, and the repository exact-head review gate, while preserving non-authoritative fixes-applied/ready-for-re-review communication.
non_goals: Do not intercept arbitrary out-of-band provider actions.
Do not create a second review framework or trust caller-supplied reviewer provenance.
Do not hard-code human verification for hosts whose configured policy does not require it.
Do not grant this implementation session independent review or merge authority.

parent.contribution: Makes the verifier boundary trustworthy before the cross-owner enforcement and delegation lanes consume it.
parent.closure_boundary: This slice may close only #2725; #2562, #2721, and the all-open-issues decomposition remain live.

owned: focused contract/generated surfaces, release changeset, and planning evidence required by #2725
effects: Ordinary start/implement decisions expose the configured verifier class and keep protected review effects outside implementation authority.
Proof admission and ordinary routing consume one separation-of-duty gate.
The repository exact-head gate continues to reject implementation-authored markers regardless of trusted GitHub association.

delegation.reason: No sub-agent delegation was requested; independent review authority must remain outside this implementation session.

next_action: Address blocking review feedback, obtain a current-head independent review for PR #2776, then merge it after PR #2766.

claims: An implementation route under human/independent policy cannot authorize self-approval or merge-ready and explicitly supports ready-for-re-review status.
Explicit status-text permission never changes actor provenance or satisfies the verifier gate.
Self-authored OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR markers remain non-authoritative while a current-head distinct configured review is accepted.
Policies without an independent verifier requirement retain their configured semantics.
requirements: Run operating-decision, startup, implement, proof-admission, PR-intake, and merge-gate fixtures.
Run routed changed-path proof, lint, typecheck, generated parity, and workspace-wide validation.
Publish a stacked PR based on the exact head of PR #2766; hosted checks and independent review remain external authority.
refs: uv run --active pytest tests/test_operating_decision.py tests/test_review_merge_gate.py tests/test_pr_comment_delta.py tests/test_workspace_cli.py::test_start_and_implement_project_human_review_boundary_before_protected_effects -q
uv run --active pytest tests/test_workspace_proof_cli.py -k "independent_review or high_assurance_closeout_posture" -q
uv run --active pytest tests/test_external_operation_clients.py -k "self_review or correction_event" -q
proof.summary: Implementation and review-marker admission repair are published in PR #2776; independent review is pending after blocker remediation.

continuation.residual_intent: After this lane, implement #2762, then #2763, then reconcile parent closure.

execution_bounds.ask_before: Adding a new review command, changing repository merge authority, merging a PR, or weakening configured verifier modes.
execution_bounds.stop_conditions: Stop if ordinary routing cannot reuse the canonical proof separation gate, or if shared credentials cannot be distinguished without a trusted actor identity.
